placement_summary: Naya is a VM-188 live-pilot placement packet for the NAYA shard expression. Its strongest source-bound signals are Green-centered life, nature, growth, ecosystem belonging, White larger-picture care, Red feral instinct and loyalty, Blue/Black absence, and anti-flattening boundaries.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Naya as abundance through living-world belonging, instinctive bond, and care for the larger natural whole. This is project interpretation from VM-181 through VM-183, not official canon; VM-188 enables it as a bounded live pilot.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana interpretation. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Life In The Larger Whole

core_values.description: Nature and growth are centered, with scale and fullness treated as expressions of life rather than generic size.
